createOrganization.title: Create an organization
createOrganization.description: Set up a new customer organization with its country, default language, time zone and currencies. Only platform administrators can do this.

name.label: Organization name
name.help: The name your customer uses, between 2 and 160 characters.

country.label: Country
country.help: DivalHR currently launches in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

locale.help: Used for the organization’s documents and notifications. Each person can still choose their own language.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.help: Used to interpret working days, shifts and deadlines.

currencies.help: Select at least one currency used for pay and expenses.

createOrganization.unauthorized: Only platform administrators can create organizations.
createOrganization.signInRequired: Sign in as a platform administrator to create organizations.

success.title: Organization created
success.body: {{name}} is ready. Its configuration is shown below.

name.LENGTH: The name must be between 2 and 160 characters.
name.FORMAT: The name cannot contain line breaks or control characters.

countryCode.FORMAT: Select a country from the list.
countryCode.NOT_SUPPORTED: This country is not supported yet.

defaultLocale.FORMAT: Choose a default language from the list.

timezone.FORMAT: Select a time zone from the list.
timezone.NOT_SUPPORTED: This time zone is not available for the selected country.

currencies.DUPLICATE: Each currency can be selected only once.
currencies.NOT_SUPPORTED: One of the selected currencies is not supported.

hierarchy.description: Legal entities, their optional regions and their sites, for your organization only.
hierarchy.unauthorized: Only organization administrators can manage the organizational structure.
hierarchy.signInRequired: Sign in as an organization administrator to manage the organizational structure.

legalEntities.empty: No legal entities yet. Add the first one below.

regionForm.periodHint: A region's dates must fall within its legal entity's dates.

regionOptions.restored: Regions loaded. You can now choose a region for a site.
regionOptions.failedAgain: Regions still could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

assignment.title: Assign {{name}} ({{code}}) to a region
assignment.hint: Choose a region of the same legal entity whose dates include the site's dates. Once assigned, the region cannot be changed.

code.label: Code
code.help: 2 to 20 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores. Stored in capitals; unique in your organization.

effectiveTo.label: End date (optional)
effectiveTo.help: Last day this applies (inclusive). Leave empty if there is no end date.

region.label: Region (optional)
region.help: Only regions of this legal entity are listed. Keep “No region” to create the site without a region.

code.LENGTH: The code must have 2 to 20 characters.
code.FORMAT: Use only letters, digits, hyphens and underscores in the code.
code.DUPLICATE_CODE: This code is already used in your organization.

name.LENGTH: The name must have 2 to 160 characters.
name.FORMAT: The name cannot contain line breaks or control characters.

countryCode.FORMAT: Select a country from the list.
countryCode.NOT_SUPPORTED: This country is not supported yet.

timezone.FORMAT: Select a time zone from the list.
timezone.NOT_SUPPORTED: This time zone is not available for the legal entity's country.

effectiveFrom.RANGE: The start date must be between 1900 and 2999.
effectiveFrom.OUTSIDE_PARENT: The start date cannot be earlier than the legal entity's start date.
effectiveFrom.OUTSIDE_SITE: The start date cannot be earlier than the site's start date.
effectiveFrom.OUTSIDE_LEGAL_ENTITY: The start date cannot be earlier than the legal entity's start date.
effectiveFrom.OUTSIDE_DEPARTMENT: The start date cannot be earlier than the department's start date.
effectiveFrom.OUTSIDE_COST_CENTER: The start date cannot be earlier than the cost center's start date.

effectiveTo.RANGE: The end date must be between 1900 and 2999.
effectiveTo.BEFORE_START: The end date cannot be earlier than the start date.
effectiveTo.OUTSIDE_PARENT: The end date must fall within the legal entity's dates. An open-ended site needs an open-ended legal entity.
effectiveTo.OUTSIDE_SITE: The end date must fall within the site's dates. An open-ended entry needs an open-ended site.
effectiveTo.OUTSIDE_LEGAL_ENTITY: The end date must fall within the legal entity's dates. An open-ended region needs an open-ended legal entity.
effectiveTo.OUTSIDE_DEPARTMENT: The end date must fall within the department's dates. An open-ended team needs an open-ended department.
effectiveTo.OUTSIDE_COST_CENTER: The end date must fall within the cost center's dates. An open-ended team needs an open-ended cost center.

regionId.MISMATCH: This region belongs to another legal entity.
